mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, shop_id AS shopId, buyer_id AS buyerId, sku_id AS skuId, product_name AS productName, quantity, amount, status, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, receiver_address AS receiverAddress, pay_time AS payTime, pay_type AS payType, trade_no AS tradeNo, ship_time AS shipTime, logistics_no AS logisticsNo, operator_id AS operatorId FROM tb_order WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order (order_no, shop_id, buyer_id, sku_id, product_name, quantity, amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{shopId}, #{buyerId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_order SET status = 1, -- 1-已支付 pay_type = #{payType}, trade_no = #{tradeNo}, pay_time = datetime('now', 'localtime'), updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

UPDATE tb_order SET status = 2, -- 2-已发货 ship_time = datetime('now', 'localtime'), logistics_no = #{logisticsNo}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
